R0.description: No fault: reference duration, quota and result count

R1.description: Worker dies after receiving the request, before any output

R2.description: Worker dies while writing the output file

R3.description: Worker dies after writing the output, before replying

R4.description: Worker dies after the reply reached the broker, before acknowledging the request

R5a.description: Reply delivered twice back to back (sequential duplicates, P2)

R5b.description: Reply delivered twice, 2 s apart (late duplicate)

R6a.description: Orchestrator dies while advancing a step (before registering the successor)

R6b.description: Orchestrator dies before persisting a final result

R6c.description: Orchestrator dies before consolidating (committing) the run

R7a.description: Cancel and restart while an old reply is held; the old reply is then delivered

R7b.description: Cancel and restart while an old write is held; the old write then lands on the new run

R8.description: Permanent error (invalid effect parameter): no endless retries, error surfaced
